prose:
The Mouseless Dev's Vim book page offers a gradual approach to Vim and Neovim in Unix-like terminals, with 170 exercises and configuration examples in both Vimscript and Lua. The author frames learning the editor as practice and adaptation rather than instant mastery.

The inspected page is promotional material, not a review of the complete manual or evidence of a measured productivity gain. Its print-availability statement has no independently checked release date, and the four-year writing claim belongs to the feed title. No AI method is established by the page itself. No book was purchased, newsletter subscribed to or editor configuration changed.
highlights: Focus is terminal Vim and Neovim
Vimscript and Lua examples are promised
AI-feed placement does not prove AI-generated content
